import Part, FreeCAD as App
V = App.Vector
def add(n, s):
    o = doc.addObject('Part::Feature', n); o.Shape = s
add('A', Part.makeBox(10, 10, 10))
add('Face', Part.makeBox(10, 10, 10, V(10, 0, 0)))
add('Edge', Part.makeBox(10, 10, 10, V(10, 10, 0)))
add('Vertex', Part.makeBox(10, 10, 10, V(10, 10, 10)))
add('Big1', Part.makeBox(100, 100, 100, V(0, 100, 0)))
add('Big2', Part.makeBox(100, 100, 100, V(100 - 1e-7, 100, 0)))
doc.recompute()
result = 'built'
